scope: Accessible exit confirmations, Startup and exit options, and configurable email list speech. This is a beta testing build.

topics.title: Startup and exit options and accessible exit confirmation
details: Startup options is renamed Startup and exit options. Start with Windows remains off by default. Ask before exiting Voice Companion, shutting down the computer, and restarting the computer are independently checked by default. Category OK saves; Cancel discards.

Escape at the main menu invokes Exit Voice Companion. The prompt asks whether you are sure and defaults to No. Arrows or Tab switch Yes and No; Enter activates. Voice yes, no, and cancel work. Escape again cancels and returns to the previous activity. When disabled, the corresponding exit or computer action proceeds without this prompt. Existing document-save protection and Windows unsaved-application handling remain.
Alt+O now announces Options menu when opening or returning to the category menu.

topics.title: Customize email headers and their order
details: Email settings restores Announce email header names, off by default. Spoken headers in order is a text field containing from, subject, date by default. Rearrange these names to change order, omit unwanted headers, or include size. At least one unique supported header is required. Changes apply across all email folders; OK saves and Cancel discards.

Size is disabled by default. Gmail reports an estimated byte size, Yahoo reports RFC822.SIZE, and Outlook reports its stored message size when available. Missing size metadata is announced as unavailable. No guessed size is spoken.
Keyboard and voice settings use the same validation. Example: set email header order subject, from, date. Header-name speech can be enabled separately without altering which values are spoken.
